notes: New Files app: the house file share (the Files drive on the server) is now in the hub, so you can browse, upload and download your files from anywhere - not just on the home network. Drag and drop to upload, tap a photo or PDF to view it, download a whole folder as a zip, and nothing is ever deleted outright: anything you remove sits in the Trash for 30 days and can be put back. The share has a fixed 250 GB cap so it can never crowd out the cameras or the system drive; the tile shows how much is used, and Stack Health warns when it gets full. Admins grant access per account under Files.
